definitions.explanation: Having as much as is needed to meet a requirement or standard.
Having more than enough, or being satisfactorily complete and thorough.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}で⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Because my experience is not sufficient, I need a bit more practice.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this explanation is thorough enough.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}した→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: After considering it with ample time, we decided on this policy.

notes:
Also used as an adverb {十分|じゅうぶん}に (sufficiently; thoroughly). Can also be read じっぷん when meaning "ten minutes," but the na-adjective meaning is always じゅうぶん. The negative form {十分|じゅうぶん}で⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ or ⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧な (insufficient) is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: enough time
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧: enough sleep
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: adequate preparation
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧: sufficient evidence
- ⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧な: insufficient; inadequate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {充分|じゅうぶん}な: sufficient — variant kanji form with the same meaning and pronunciation; both are standard
- ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to be enough — a verb rather than an adjective; more conversational
- ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な: abundant; rich — implies having much more than needed, especially variety
